dsp GenModalWoodBarSoftShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.7 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.93 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.18 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.4 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.07 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 19.8 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2700

dsp GenModalWoodBarSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.7 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.93 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.18 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.4 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.07 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 19.8 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2736

dsp GenModalWoodBarMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.7 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.93 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.18 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.4 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.07 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 19.8 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2676

dsp GenModalWoodBarMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.7 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.93 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.18 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.4 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.07 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 19.8 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2711

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.7 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.93 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.18 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.4 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.07 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 19.8 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2683

dsp GenModalMarimbaBarMediumShort where

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 4.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.0 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.1143

dsp GenModalMarimbaBarMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 4.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 10.0 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.1179

dsp GenModalVibeBarSoftShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.98 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 9.94 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.1801

dsp GenModalVibeBarMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.98 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 9.94 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.1775

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 3.98 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 9.94 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.317543) * 1.1825

  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.28 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2166

dsp GenModalGlassBarSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.28 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2323

dsp GenModalGlassBarMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.28 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.2164

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.28 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.12 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate

dsp GenModalSteelBarSoftShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.7 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.3 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.15 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.479858 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 13.34 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA

dsp GenModalSteelBarSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.7 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.3 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.15 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.180273 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 13.34 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.245967) * 1.1600

dsp GenModalSteelBarMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.7 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.3 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.15 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.479858 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 13.34 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate

dsp GenModalSteelBarMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.7 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.3 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.15 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.180273 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 13.34 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.245967) * 1.1605

dsp GenModalSteelBarHardRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.7 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.756 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.45 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 5.404 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.3 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 8.933 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.15 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.180273 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 13.34 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.245967) * 1.1617

dsp GenModalChurchBellSoftShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state p5 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e5 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 0.5 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 1.2 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 1.5 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.479858 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 2.0 / sr))
    let e5A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.75), e5 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.435275 * sr)))
    set e5 := e5A
    set p5 := fract(p5 + min(0.45, freq * 2.5 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + sinpi(p5 * 2.0) * e5A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.224537) * 0.9824

dsp GenModalChurchBellSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state p5 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e5 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 0.5 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 1.2 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 1.5 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.180273 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 2.0 / sr))
    let e5A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.75), e5 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.143587 * sr)))
    set e5 := e5A
    set p5 := fract(p5 + min(0.45, freq * 2.5 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + sinpi(p5 * 2.0) * e5A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.224537) * 0.9904

dsp GenModalChurchBellMediumShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state p5 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e5 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 0.5 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 1.2 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 1.5 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.479858 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 2.0 / sr))
    let e5A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.75), e5 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.435275 * sr)))
    set e5 := e5A
    set p5 := fract(p5 + min(0.45, freq * 2.5 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + sinpi(p5 * 2.0) * e5A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.224537) * 0.9818

dsp GenModalChurchBellMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state p5 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e5 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 0.5 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 1.2 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 1.5 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.180273 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 2.0 / sr))
    let e5A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.75), e5 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.143587 * sr)))
    set e5 := e5A
    set p5 := fract(p5 + min(0.45, freq * 2.5 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + sinpi(p4 * 2.0) * e4A + sinpi(p5 * 2.0) * e5A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.224537) * 0.9898

dsp GenModalChurchBellHardShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 5.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state p4 : F32 := 0.0
  state p5 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e5 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 0.5 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 1.2 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.4 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 1.5 / sr))
    let e4A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 1.4), e4 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.479858 * sr)))
    set e4 := e4A
    set p4 := fract(p4 + min(0.45, freq * 2.0 / sr))
    let e5A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.75), e5 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.435275 * sr)))
    set e5 := e5A
    set p5 := fract(p5 + min(0.45, freq * 2.5 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA

dsp GenModalChurchBellHardRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  state p0 : F32 := 0.0

  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0

  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e4 : F32 := 0.0
  state e5 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 0.6 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 0.5 / sr))

    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.6 / sr))

dsp GenModalHandBellSoftRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.4 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.9 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.6 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1817

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.4 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.9 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.6 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1719

dsp GenModalHandBellMediumRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.4 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.9 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.6 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 0.8, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.012 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1797

dsp GenModalHandBellHardShort where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.754272 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.4 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.623084 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.9 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.539145 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.6 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1693

modalHandBellHardRing.source:
dsp GenModalHandBellHardRing where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state p0 : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state e0 : F32 := 0.0
  state e1 : F32 := 0.0
  state e2 : F32 := 0.0
  state e3 : F32 := 0.0
  state click : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let e0A := select(trigger, gate * 1.0 * (1.0 + colour * 0.0), e0 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set e0 := e0A
    set p0 := fract(p0 + min(0.45, freq * 1.0 / sr))
    let e1A := select(trigger, gate * 0.5 * (1.0 + colour * 0.35), e1 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.517883 * sr)))
    set e1 := e1A
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, freq * 2.4 / sr))
    let e2A := select(trigger, gate * 0.35 * (1.0 + colour * 0.7), e2 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.331595 * sr)))
    set e2 := e2A
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, freq * 3.9 / sr))
    let e3A := select(trigger, gate * 0.2 * (1.0 + colour * 1.05), e3 * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.23658 * sr)))
    set e3 := e3A
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, freq * 5.6 / sr))
    let clickA := select(trigger, gate * 1.2, click * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set click := clickA
    let lpA := nz * clickA * (0.3 + colour * 0.5)
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p0 * 2.0) * e0A + sinpi(p1 * 2.0) * e1A + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * e2A + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * e3A + lpA * 0.5) * 0.275) * 1.1801
